description: Defines the pusch_channel_estimator_metrics_aggregator class, which aggregates metrics related to PUSCH channel estimation, including latency, processing rate, and CPU usage.

classes.name: pusch_channel_estimator_metrics_aggregator
classes.description: A class that aggregates and provides metrics for PUSCH channel estimation, including latency, processing rate, and CPU usage.

methods.name: get_average_latency
methods.description: Returns the average channel estimation latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_min_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the minimum processing latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_max_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the maximum processing latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_processing_rate
methods.description: Returns the average PRB processing rate in millions of PRB-per-second.

methods.name: get_total_time
methods.description: Returns the total execution time of the channel estimation as a duration.

methods.name: get_cpu_usage_us
methods.description: Returns the CPU usage in microseconds.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all internal counters and metrics.
